title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg with one paused solver, a full gc.collect() and PETSc garbage cleanup after every taped solve: is the remaining RSS growth uncollected garbage
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb); ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs; alone on the machine (no other session's process in a 10 s CPU log)
resources: 8 ranks; RSS a rank (mean over ranks) 1003 MiB after the first taped solve, 1112 MiB after the last (3.5 MiB an evaluation, against 3.8 without the cleanup); peak 1409 MiB
cost: 239 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 6.77 s an evaluation (median after the first), 0.13 s above test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-after
audit: every objective within 5.6e-12 of test-32km-inversion-reuse-lbfgs-after; the growth stays: memory something still holds, which a collection does not release
notes: the probe wrapper's PROBE_GC=1 calls firedrake.petsc.garbage_cleanup on every rank after every taped solve
